lead_raw_text:
The structure of Fe2Co2Si2Se16 (reduced formula FeCoSiSe8) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 22 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Fe each coordinated by six Se neighbors, while Si adopts a tetrahedral environment with four Se neighbors; Se centers display three- and four-coordinate geometries. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Si tetrahedra and both Co- and Fe-centered six-vertex polyhedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing among like Co and Fe polyhedra.
